alignment_protocol.video_start_source: Original inner-ZIP extended Unix modification time minus decoded video duration.
alignment_protocol.assumption: The archived modification time is close to the end of recording; file flush latency and cross-device clock offsets are unknown.
alignment_protocol.supporting_evidence: Reference ZIP file modification seconds coincide with the final recorded notification/session stop seconds; container and sampled video do not supply a verified shared timestamp.
alignment_protocol.shift_sign: Positive shifts place video start later on the reference UTC clock.
alignment_protocol.sensitivity_interpretation: Illustrative timestamp-assumption shifts only, not a confidence interval, error bound, or selection of the smallest error.
alignment_protocol.reference_kind: User-designated Polar device HR notifications; not ECG; physiological notification delay is unknown.
alignment_protocol.reference_aggregation: Arithmetic mean of finite positive HR notifications in [window_center-5,window_center+5).
alignment_protocol.reference_coverage: Window must lie inside first-reference to last-reference plus median interval; at least two reference values; no internal timestamp gap greater than 2 seconds.
alignment_protocol.reporting: Primary metrics remain conditional on this timestamp assumption; all six frozen branches, own and common windows, output coverage and full-reference R5 denominators.
alignment_protocol.waveform_snr: Hann full-window Welch, NFFT=8192, band 0.7–3.5 Hz, reference HR H1 +/-0.1 Hz.

source_protocol_v22.default: trimmed_gap10; gap15 is an explicitly separate continuity option
source_protocol_v22.unchanged: Detector/ROI/mask/quality thresholds; POS/CHROM, band, 10s HR window and 1s step; final HR from saved fused waveform.
source_protocol_v22.gap_rounding_fix: Use floor(gap_s*fps), not nearest round: maximum missing duration cannot exceed the chosen limit. At fractional 30fps, .15s bridges at most 4 missing frames.
source_protocol_v22.duplicate_policy: Kaggle first60 and user0907 playback derivatives are excluded as duplicate captures.
source_protocol_v22.reference_policy: No references supplied to inference. Existing fixed UBFC and data1 timing protocols used only after all predictions.
source_protocol_v22.selection: Previously inspected development/regression set; no held-out generalization claim. All candidates reported; no parameter sweep or best-shift selection.
source_protocol_v22.metrics: Report own/common/newly-output MAE RMSE Bias P5 R5, output/waveform coverage, HR runs/outages, reference H1 SNR; no-reference errors stay NA.

source_protocol_v23.reference_policy: No references in inference; frozen existing alignment and all seven data1 sensitivity shifts.
source_protocol_v23.unchanged: V22 face geometry/decisions/masks, 10s windows, 1s step, quality gates, POS/CHROM, fusion, actual-waveform HR readout.
source_protocol_v23.candidate_signal: Paired patch log-color changes, with explicitly marked baseline ratio fallback and gap resets; relative-color reconstruction, not raw RGB.
source_protocol_v23.population: Five human source videos plus one synthetic control; overlapping windows are not independent subjects; development/regression only.

Frozen source hashes, input identities, reference alignment and evaluator dependencies verified
V22 baseline metrics and reference-H1 SNR reproduced
Same frontend trace shared exactly across its gap10/gap15 modes
Face source, detection/flow flags, bounding boxes and times equal frozen V22 geometry trace for every frame
Original fusion and HR gates unchanged; rejected final HR remains missing, not numeric
Saved waveform and HR timelines consistent; full-waveform replay QA receipt verified
Required meaningful unit and regression checks pass
interpretation: All videos are previously inspected development/regression data; passing is not held-out or clinical generalization evidence
data1 synchronization remains estimated; evaluate all seven shifts without choosing the best shift
No-reference MAE, RMSE, P5, R5 and reference-H1 SNR are NA, never zero accuracy error
Coverage is not accuracy; interpolation and neighboring-window coverage must be disclosed
Candidate identity and thresholds are never changed after seeing results
A failed default gate keeps the V22 default; gap15 is evaluated only as its separately named option

default.note: Development/regression gate only. data1 timing is estimated. Evaluator does not install or switch defaults.

separate_continuity_option.note: Development/regression gate only. data1 timing is estimated. Evaluator does not install or switch defaults.

v23_checks: HR rejection duration uses explicit decision-grid convention

receipt.methodology: Independent saved-waveform Welch, gate and offline DP recomputation; fusion provenance rebuilt from positive contributor weights; no production estimator imported.

definitions.error: Predicted minus reference BPM. Own windows differ; paired common/new/lost retain full Nplanned and Nref denominators.
definitions.P5: 100 * Nwithin5 / Nvalid; R5 = 100 * Nwithin5 / Nref. No reference produces NA.
definitions.primary_HR: Final HR read from saved waveform output; offline_ridge and local_peak both reported and guarded.
definitions.rejected_diagnostics: Fusion rejected HR columns stay missing. POS/CHROM local-peak column may retain a pre-gate diffuse-spectrum diagnostic; accepted=False always excludes it from coverage and scoring, and aligned output separates that diagnostic from prediction.
definitions.SNR: Frozen V22 reference-H1 periodic Hann full window, nfft>=8192, .7-3.5Hz, reference H1 +/- .1Hz versus remaining band; accepted HR, finite full waveform and eligible reference required.
definitions.common: Strict common across all versions is descriptive; upgrade uses pairwise common against its same-gap baseline.
definitions.waveform_coverage: Finite saved base samples / all original video frames. It includes marked interpolation and neighboring-window contributions and is not physiological accuracy.
definitions.interruption: HR longest rejected grid run is rejected decision count * actual step duration; first-to-last rejected-center span is also reported. Waveform longest missing run is missing sample count / FPS. Both include boundary missing runs.
definitions.support: Accepted HR support intervals are unioned; overlapping ten-second windows are never summed into validated duration.
definitions.proxies: Peak concentration is an engineering frequency concentration proxy, not a probability of correctness.
definitions.frontend: Geometry source/flags and missingness are identical; numeric fields allow only absolute 1e-9 CSV round-trip tolerance, with maxima disclosed. Pixel-source percentages use all video frames per ROI and distinguish tracked ratios, baseline fallback, reset, and missing samples.
definitions.LoA: Bias +/- 1.96 sample SD, descriptive only; highly overlapping windows are not independent.

limitations: All six sources were previously inspected development/regression data; not held-out generalization evidence.
Five human recordings plus one synthetic generator do not establish six independent participants.
UBFC uses paired device HR, not ECG. data1 absolute synchronization remains estimated.
All seven data1 shifts are disclosed without selecting a best shift or fitting timing.
No-reference videos have no measurable HR accuracy. Synthetic 72 bpm is an engineering control.
No qualified waveform morphology reference; r_wave is NA. Coverage or reference-H1 SNR does not establish morphology recovery.
